summary: Decide synchronous clock/capacity callback lock policy before U37 acceptance

detail.finding: The new U37 HostClock callbacks are reached under existing session and queue mutexes. meguri-ffi/AGENTS.md prohibits every Swift callback under a lock; KTD9 states the no-lock rule under event delivery and U37 requires synchronous host inputs.
detail.proposed_exception: Permit only HostClock and DiskSpaceProvider synchronous platform-value callbacks while core locks are held. These trusted host implementations must return bounded values, never call the core, never perform UI or async work, and always run through callback::invoke. Event/progress/search/host delivery and all other callbacks retain the existing no-lock rule. Keep reentry protection and focused tests.
detail.alternative: Keep the unconditional rule and refactor engine time/capacity acquisition to sample before locks; no exception may be assumed.
detail.acceptance: U37 remains unaccepted until this decision is implemented and reviewed. Compiler, privacy and control-wait repairs can proceed independently.
